findings.summary: Second Ox Watchdog execution on the SAME commit 0843acb just 65s after twin run 32880292058 (created 17:51:59Z vs 17:50:54Z), both event=workflow_run, both success. Diff of the two raw logs is timestamps-only; the nine per-workflow outcomes are semantically identical (graph/intel/product/runtime/cto-council active; physics-loop latest success 32866107906; meta-sync/product-beta-repair/frontier-research zero completed runs). Mechanism: workflow_run triggers re-fire the watchdog for each upstream completion, so multi-lane completion bursts produce back-to-back redundant sweeps. Not a malfunction - a pure orchestration-cost noise pattern consistent with the ~5.6 orchestration runs/h quantified in runs/32880942022.json.

research_opportunities: Same debounce/single-flight-lock idea recorded in runs/32880292058.json: this twin is the concrete second data-point showing redundant watchdog sweeps during completion bursts.
